result.instructions: Tools for SkuVault, hosted by usefulapi.io. If the user is new or asks what this server can do, suggest requests such as: "Which SKUs are below their reorder point?"; "Show the sales that are ready to ship and what is in stock for them."; "Which purchase orders are still open, and from which suppliers?". Read-only tools never change data; ask the user before a tool that creates, changes or deletes SkuVault data. Free plan: 50 tool calls per month. Run skuvault_usage_status to see the calls used this month. If the user asks for something none of these tools can do, tell the user and, with their OK, run skuvault_request_feature to record the request. Paid plan: Pro (unlimited tool calls (fair use limit: 10,000 a month), $9/month or $90/year). Pro can be cancelled at any time and then runs to the end of the paid period, so it also suits a one-time job. When the user wants more calls or reaches the limit, run skuvault_upgrade (plan "monthly" or "yearly"); it returns a payment link for the user to open. skuvault_cancel_subscription cancels Pro at the end of the paid period.

tools.name: skuvault_list_warehouses
tools.title: List warehouses
tools.description: List the regular warehouses (Id and Code). The numeric Id is what the stock tools and skuvault_list_transactions need. SkuVault throttles this call to 1 per minute. POST /inventory/getWarehouses.

page.description: Vendor page number, starting at 0 (default 0). Pass `next.page` from the previous reply.

tools.name: skuvault_list_locations
tools.title: List locations
tools.description: List the locations in enabled warehouses with warehouse, location code, parent location/container and total quantity. Heavy throttling (5/min). POST /inventory/getLocations.

skip.description: Items to skip inside the vendor page (default 0). Pass `next.skip` from the previous reply.

limit.description: How many items to return from the vendor page, 1-500 (default 50). SkuVault pages hold 1,000-10,000 rows, so a window is shown.

tools.name: skuvault_list_products
tools.title: List products
tools.description: List products (not kits) with description, cost, prices, brand, supplier, classification, reorder point and quantities (on hand, available, pending, picked, incoming...). Filter by SKU or code, or by modification time. Alternate SKUs come back as separate rows (IsAlternateSKU) unless you filter. Heavy throttling (5/min). POST /products/getProducts.

modified_after.description: Only products modified at or after this time.

modified_before.description: Only products modified before this time.

page.description: Vendor page number, starting at 0 (default 0). Pass `next.page` from the previous reply.

skip.description: Items to skip inside the vendor page (default 0). Pass `next.skip` from the previous reply.

limit.description: How many items to return from the vendor page, 1-500 (default 50). SkuVault pages hold 1,000-10,000 rows, so a window is shown.

tools.name: skuvault_get_product
tools.title: Get product
tools.description: One product (not a kit) by SKU or by code: details plus all quantities (on hand, available, pending, picked, incoming, in stock). Give exactly one of sku or code. Light throttling (20/min). POST /products/getProduct.

tools.name: skuvault_list_kits
tools.title: List kits
tools.description: List kits with their component lines, optional available quantity and cost. Needs a modified-time window (defaults to all time). The page size is not documented: keep following `next` until a page comes back empty. Heavy throttling (5/min). POST /products/getKits.

modified_after.description: Only kits modified at or after this time (default: all time).

modified_before.description: Only kits modified before this time (default: now).

include_available_quantity.description: Also compute the available quantity of each kit (default false: it is 0).

include_cost.description: Also return the kit cost (default false).

page.description: Vendor page number, starting at 0 (default 0). Pass `next.page` from the previous reply.

skip.description: Items to skip inside the vendor page (default 0). Pass `next.skip` from the previous reply.

limit.description: How many items to return from the vendor page, 1-500 (default 50). SkuVault pages hold 1,000-10,000 rows, so a window is shown.

tools.name: skuvault_list_integrations

tools.description: List the enabled sales-channel accounts (Amazon, ChannelAdvisor, Shopify...): Id, LongId, Name and Type. Severe throttling (1/min). POST /integration/getIntegrations.

tools.name: skuvault_add_stock
tools.title: Add stock
tools.description: WRITE: add quantity of a product to a warehouse location (a transaction in SkuVault's history; every call adds again, so do not retry blindly). The transaction reason must already exist in SkuVault. Serialized or lotted products need serial numbers / a scanned lot code. Moderate throttling (10/min). POST /inventory/addItem.

warehouse_id.description: SkuVault warehouse id (an integer; see skuvault_list_warehouses).

location_code.description: Location the quantity is added to.

quantity.description: Quantity to add (a positive whole number).

reason.description: Transaction reason; must already exist in SkuVault.

lot_code.description: Lot number (ScannedCode); required when adding to a lotted product.

serial_numbers.description: Serial numbers, as many as the quantity; only for serialized products.

tools.name: skuvault_remove_stock
tools.title: Remove stock
tools.description: WRITE: remove quantity of a product from a warehouse location (a transaction in SkuVault's history; every call removes again, so do not retry blindly). The transaction reason must already exist in SkuVault. Serialized products need serial numbers. Moderate throttling (10/min). POST /inventory/removeItem.

warehouse_id.description: SkuVault warehouse id (an integer; see skuvault_list_warehouses).

location_code.description: Location the quantity is removed from.

quantity.description: Quantity to remove (a positive whole number).

reason.description: Transaction reason; must already exist in SkuVault.

serial_numbers.description: Serial numbers, as many as the quantity; only for serialized products.

tools.name: skuvault_set_stock_quantity
tools.title: Set stock quantity
tools.description: WRITE: set the exact quantity of a product at one warehouse location, overwriting what is there (running it again with the same values changes nothing more). Use skuvault_get_inventory_by_location first to see the current quantity. Moderate throttling (10/min). POST /inventory/setItemQuantity.

warehouse_id.description: SkuVault warehouse id (an integer; see skuvault_list_warehouses).

quantity.description: The new quantity at that location (0 or more).
